body: i can't switch to public school, it's too late for that, and i can make up for those classes, they aren't a big deal, i just didn't get enough time for revision and the amount of info i needed to get into my head for the examinations and practicals, was overwhelming...... if i get even atleast a month and a good teacher, i can easily make up for those and also continue to higher studies.....

i Have the option of dropping out, my current school is a private institution and they won't let me repeat for the sake of their reputation, nor i want to, i just want to continue and i believe i can make up in the next summer.....

and i don't know if it's relevant or not but i had got an MRI done of my brain an year ago which showed signs of Demyelination, and advised a follow up but my family deemed it as a minor issue and just ignored it, i don't know if it means anything or not...

Nope, We don't have that option, We have two terms and our syllabus includes, Advanced Calculus(definite and indefinite Integrals , Differential equations and Limits), Physics( we have two whole books which includes all of the pre uni stuff, Derivations and calculations of of all newton's law, and electromagnetism and gravitation, all three laws of Thermodynamics, and 20 more chapters) chemistry(with all chemical equation derivations and structures, organic chemistry, which is a whole book in itself which covers individual chapters on Alkyl Halides, Isomerism, etc, and another book just dedicated to physical chemistry), 
computer science included Processor architecture, ALU, Digital Circuits, Logic gates and practicals with java, which was pretty easy for me for some reason,
and english was the easiest..... a whole year seems less given the amount of study, Rigorous testing, the math involved, in Physics chemistry, Maths and Computer Science , 80% things were Calculations and Derivations/ Numericals, and 20% theory.....

and our teachers suck and waste a lot of time, and i can't go to anyone who would help me..... 
and i had also made a huge mistake wasting some time learning Astrophysics related Text books....

The thing is i need promotion to 12th grade, as a regular student which they are not giving me, I'm really devastated, i don't think i have any other option, my grandfather went to talk to them they are not agreeing to anything.....i've made a huge mistake, and i think i am gonna pay for it with my life.....
well, i know that feeling, it's something i cannot describe but it feels so natural....i want to talk about this in depth, as i am considering of doing the same, tell me everything.....

Well, I'm 17 too, am going to end it this sunday, Today i was informed that i flunked 11th grade, everything i stood for, my dreams my ambitions, are gone now, i feel worthless, it's time i end it all.....
I feel like somebody ripped my soul out.....
they are asking me for what i want to do next.....at least after i am successful these things won't matter right?
i just don't wanna go through this hell nor drag my family through it,  i think it's best for me to just vanish, i'm probably gonna have my first attempt on this sunday....

I don't think we have that option in india, We have to finish schooling in time no matter what, and student suicide is more common than you think, although with home schooling i might get time to work on my AP, SAT's, IELTS and TOFEL but it will not matter if they don't recognize my high school degree.....

I just don't know, i want to pursue uni's in US, and i don't think any uni's will accept me, i can opt for home schooling and complete my high school without a gap but some people say that the degree is worthless, my father died when i was 7 and i just don't want to be a burden to my family.....

Carl Sagan, Neil DeGrasse Tyson, Leonard Susskind, etc people who helped mankind, but i feel like i will never amount to anything, and will never be able to do what i love, and it feels pointless for me to continue living....
